title: feat(console): preview images, PDF, text and CSV in the page from attachments and file fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Fixes #36442
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 控制台用户在记录的附件列表点文件名、或在文件字段点文件链接时，图片、PDF、纯文本和表格文件直接在页面弹窗里看，不再先下载；Word、Excel、PPT 仍只能下载。
- 这是附件预览决策选定的方案甲（页内预览，社区版默认）的界面半边，服务端那半边由同区另一张卡负责。
- 若出错，最坏是预览打不开、用户点弹窗里的下载或新标签页照旧拿到文件；没有下载权限的人在预览里同样被拒；可整体撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

A shared `FilePreviewDialog` in `@object-ui/fields` (decision #34781, option A), opened from a record's attachments and from a file field:

- **Views, no new dependency.** Image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, and SVG through an `img` element only) via the lightbox's own image element (`LightboxImageView`, extracted from `ImageLightbox`); PDF in an `iframe` on the browser's own viewer, without a `sandbox` attribute; plain text as text; CSV as a table, read with the GBK-aware `decodeSpreadsheetText` and `parseDelimited`, which moved down from `@object-ui/plugin-grid` (it now imports them from `@object-ui/fields`; no copy).
- **Download only.** Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML and every other type: "This file type cannot be previewed. Please download it." HTML was measured as a choice between "unsupported" and "source as text"; this PR takes **unsupported**: nothing is fetched, nothing is framed, nothing is drawn. A declared HTML type wins over a harmless name, and an `.html` name wins over a declared plain-text type.
- **The PDF frame needs a PDF signal**: the declared `application/pdf`, or a `.pdf` name when no type is declared. A `.pdf` name with another declared type (for example `application/octet-stream`) is unsupported, so the frame never receives bytes the browser would read as anything else.
- **Limits** (maintainer defaults): images and PDF 20 MB, text and CSV 2 MB, judged on the declared size before anything is fetched and on the bytes read when no size is declared; text and CSV show their first 1000 lines (CSV: header plus 1000 rows). Past a limit: "too large, please download" with a download button.
- **Controls**: previous / next (and the arrow keys) across a record's attachments; download; open in a new tab.
- **Same door as the download.** In the attachments panel the preview mints its link with the download's own call (`/files/:id/url` with the console's token, now one `signedUrlFor` both use), and a refusal shows the download's own copy. On a file field the preview uses the field's own link (the stable `/files/:id` endpoint) and first asks it with `redirect: 'manual'`: a redirect is the grant, a 401/403 is the refusal, so no byte moves twice.
- **Phone**: below the `useIsMobile` breakpoint a PDF is offered in a new tab (the system viewer), never framed; image, text and CSV stay in the page.
- **Cross-origin bucket** (the contract in #36443 / #36565): text and CSV are read with a `GET` on the signed link from the page; when the browser refuses that read (no bucket CORS rule for the console origin), the dialog offers "Open in new tab" instead.
- **Wiring**: `RecordAttachmentsPanel`, the row's name is now a button that opens the preview (download stays in the row's menu); `FileValueAffordance` (`file-affordance.tsx`), a plain click opens the preview, a modified click keeps the link's own new tab, and a click inside the dialog does not bubble to the grid row behind its portal.
- **Copy**: 15 new keys under `fields.filePreview` in all 12 packs (zh-Hant regenerated from zh-Hans by its generator).

New public exports from `@object-ui/fields` (preferred names, built under them): `FilePreviewDialog`, `FilePreviewDialogProps`, `FilePreviewItem`, `decodeSpreadsheetText`, `parseDelimited`. Alternatives considered: `FileViewerDialog` / `FileViewerDialogProps` / `FileViewerItem`.

New `@object-ui/i18n` keys (every pack): `fields.filePreview.title`, `fields.filePreview.previous`, `fields.filePreview.next`, `fields.filePreview.download`, `fields.filePreview.openInNewTab`, `fields.filePreview.loading`, `fields.filePreview.tooLarge`, `fields.filePreview.unsupported`, `fields.filePreview.denied`, `fields.filePreview.loadFailed`, `fields.filePreview.blocked`, `fields.filePreview.pdfOutside`, `fields.filePreview.truncatedRows`, `fields.filePreview.truncatedLines`, `fields.filePreview.empty`.

Read first, by risk: `filePreviewKind` (which bytes may reach the `iframe`), `useResolver` in `FilePreviewDialog.tsx` (the refusal probe and the one-resolver-per-dialog rule), then `previewSignedUrl` / `signedUrlFor` in `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/FilePreviewDialog-36442.test.tsx` shows 51 passing.

## Tests

- New card-named file `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/FilePreviewDialog-36442.test.tsx`: the kind table (Office, HTML, SVG, PDF-signal cases); each view and its element; SVG only as `img`, no `iframe`/`object`, bytes never fetched; text drawn as text (a script tag in the file stays text); GBK CSV; the 1000-row cap; Office and HTML download only with nothing resolved, fetched or framed; too large per kind, a control at exactly the limit, and a text file judged on its bytes; the refusal from `resolveUrl`, from the default probe (403), from the text read (403), with a redirect as the control; the CORS-blocked read offering the new tab; previous / next / arrow keys / wrap; download and new tab; phone PDF in a new tab and phone image in the page; the field link opening the preview, a modified click not, a refused field file, a Word field file.
- Shared harness `RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe`: the name opens the preview on the signed link, next walks to the next row's own link, a refused reader gets the download's copy (and the link is asked once), a Word file offers only the download and that download is the row menu's, the row menu still carries Download.
- Shared harness `importParsers.test.ts`, new `describe`: the wizard's `parseDelimited` / `decodeSpreadsheetText` are the very functions `@object-ui/fields` exports.
- Tests changed because the product changed: none. Existing pins that query `getByText('report.pdf')` keep passing on the new name button.

## Acceptance notes

- **Multi-file field values preview one file at a time.** A file field holding several files opens each file's own preview without previous / next across the value: the group lives at the call sites in `FileField.tsx` and the cell renderer in the fields barrel, outside this card's claimed file surface. The attachments panel walks its whole list.
- "Phone" is the console's viewport breakpoint (`useIsMobile`, under 768 px), not a device check.
- #36518 (open): answers stored bytes outside an inline allow-list as attachments, keeps PDF and plain text inline. Effect here: none on the in-page views (the text and CSV views read bytes with `fetch`, which ignores the disposition; #36565 measured Chromium mounting its PDF viewer under that PR's sandbox header). The "Open in new tab" for a CSV would download it rather than display it once #36518 lands.
- On S3, the PDF frame needs #36565's `frame-src` and the text and CSV reads need the bucket CORS rule #36443 documents; without them the dialog offers the new tab, as that card's contract states.
- The pre-existing `FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED` (field-owned files) has no friendly copy in the attachments panel's mapper; the panel only maps `ATTACHMENT_DOWNLOAD_DENIED`. The preview shows exactly what the download shows. Observation only.

## Verification

Screenshots: NOT MEASURED. Reason: the relay writes text bodies only and no write door here uploads an image to a pull request; a live Console run was not started in this container.
